crossRefs.note: God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.
Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
Thus all Israel brought the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and…
also the Levites who were the singers, all of them, even Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers…
when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking Yahweh; and when…
Hezekiah commanded them to offer the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering began, Yahweh’s song also…
Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from…
He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”

translations.web: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, Yahweh.
translations.bsb: With trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn shout for joy before the LORD, the King.
translations.kjv: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.
translations.asv: With trumpets and sound of cornet Make a joyful noise before the King, Jehovah.
